name: Order of Geuzen
source:
In 1930 Oldenzaal, the Netherlands is under a new regime, but shadows stir beyond its streets. Experience Sofia’s perilous journey.

[From [url=https://gafaszt2.itch.io/order-of-geuzen]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1930年的奥尔登扎尔，荷兰正处于新政权的统治之下，然而街巷之外暗影已在悄然涌动。亲历索菲娅步步惊心的险途吧。

[摘自[url=https://gafaszt2.itch.io/order-of-geuzen]itch.io[/url]]
